verdict.justification: Both deliverables cover all eight requested systems, provide 33 wells with criterion-by-criterion screening, and identify the same seven qualifying wells in a second tab. B is more decision-ready because its candidate tab includes a "Priority Rank" and "PM Comment," keeping the recommendations and verification needs alongside the well data rather than only in the email. B also explicitly flags conflicts between the factsheet narratives and well tables, particularly that Farmer City Well 7 is "active in the IEPA well table but not named in the system narrative," which is important for a lead recommendation. A overstates the evidence by calling the leading wells the "only qualifying wells with substantial reported pumpage" and describing Well 9 as "proven production," despite acknowledging that pumpage is not available capacity. B offers a clearer follow-up plan to confirm status, available capacity, supply agreements, and water quality, while consistently distinguishing screening success from a capacity guarantee. B does have a minor internal error in claiming every well passing the description rule has Status A, but this does not change the seven-well shortlist.

decisive_issues.issue: The recommendation overstates what reported pumpage establishes and dismisses other qualifying wells' pumpage without a defined threshold.
